artworks.title: Cavalry Engagement
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The drawing shows a cavalry charge in the midst of a battle. The focus is on horses galloping with armored riders. In the background, there are cavalry and foot soldiers fighting. The horses and riders are in dynamic poses, showing intensity. The drawing is detailed with textures and expressions.

artworks.title: Cavalry Attack on a Walled Fortress
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The drawing depicts a chaotic and energetic battle with several figures clothed in armor and wielding weapons, mounted on horses. To the left of the image, a group appears to be engaged in combat with massive creatures, resembling elephants, amidst billowing smoke or dust. The action centers around two horsemen, prominently positioned in the foreground on the right, seemingly leading the charge, one of whom is pointing or commanding others in the fray. Behind them, a cavalry charge is visible, with flags flying and more soldiers engulfed in the turmoil of battle. The scene is crowded, energetic, and filled with intricate, swirling lines creating a sense of frenetic movement and urgency. This image is rendered in a highly detailed, intricate linework typical of historical battle depictions.

artworks.title: Battle Scene with Cavalry Observing from a Hill
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a group of soldiers on horseback in the foreground, facing right. The horses are detailed with musculature and flowing manes. In the background, troops are seen in formation holding spears and shields, engaged in battle. The setting includes fortifications, a castle, and hills. The illustration is highly detailed, capturing a historical battle scene.

artworks.title: Battle Scene with Two Horses Attacking Each Other
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The artwork depicts a medieval battle with soldiers and horses clashing. The foreground is filled with combat, showing fallen figures and rearing horses. Details in the armor and weapons add to the realism of the scene. In the background, a fortified city with walls and gates can be seen, with figures engaged in battle approaching the city. The drawing uses contrasts and lines to convey movement and energy.

artworks.title: Cavalry Charge with Soldiers and Horses Trampled
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with armored horses and warriors. The composition features detailed figures engaged in combat. Warriors are seen clad in armor and wielding weapons, while the horses are depicted with intricate musculature and movement. This artwork is done in the style of Leonardo da Vinci.

artworks.title: Battle between Cavalry and Infantry
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with knights and horses engaged in combat. The scene features armored figures wielding swords and shields, with several horses rearing or fallen. The use of fine lines and strong contrasts adds to the intensity of the scene. The panel's composition captures the movement of a historic battle.

artworks.title: Cavalry Attack with Soldiers Fleeing
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. Numerous armored figures are engaged in combat atop horses. The composition is detailed with lances and swords creating diagonals. The muscles and expressions of the horses convey the intensity of the battle. The figures wear intricately designed armor. The drawing captures a moment in a battle, with movement and conflict. The textures and lines are finely rendered.

artworks.title: Cavalry Engagement
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with horses. The artwork shows a chaotic battlefield with numerous horses engaged in combat. The horses are depicted in dynamic poses, some rearing up and others falling. Details such as limbs, muscles, and flowing manes are rendered with intricate linework. The composition is dense, with little space between the figures, emphasizing the intensity of the clash. Contrast and shading bring depth to the scene. The drawing captures the energy and motion of a battle.

artworks.title: Cavalry Attack with Soldiers Fleeing
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a battle scene. The image shows a confrontation between mounted and foot soldiers engaged in combat with spears and swords. Some soldiers are fighting in close combat, while others are attacking or defending. A central figure on horseback is prominent in the scene. The drawing is detailed with intricate line work, capturing the movement and tension of the skirmish. The background depicts a rocky terrain, setting the scene in a battlefield environment. The composition conveys a sense of action and drama, typical of historical battle depictions.

artworks.title: Six Cavalrymen in Combat
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of horses in motion. The image depicts four horses, with one horse prominently depicted on its back. The horses are adorned with flowing manes, and their dynamic poses suggest a narrative of action. The intricate line work and attention to the musculature of the animals emphasize their power and grace. The composition is tightly packed, with the horses almost overlapping each other.

artworks.title: The Taking of Cartagena
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene surrounding a heavily fortified city. The illustration depicts warriors engaging in combat, some climbing walls with ladders, and others fighting with various weapons, including shields and spears. The setting includes stone towers and walls, trees on the left, and battling groups extending into the background. Banners and the positioning of the warriors add to the dramatic tension of the scene, highlighting the chaos of sieges during warfare.

artworks.title: Young Peasant Seated on the Ground [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk with touches of white heightening on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 34.2 x 26.8 cm (13 7/16 x 10 9/16 in.)
support: 47.6 x 37.8 cm (18 3/4 x 14 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person in a crouching position, depicted from head to toe. The individual's head is slightly tilted with their eyes looking forward. They have short, smooth hair and a detailed face. They are dressed in a loose-fitting, long-sleeved shirt. The drawing emphasizes the muscles and contours of the limbs, particularly the forearm and leg. One arm is extended outward with the hand facing up. The background is plain with a textured paper surface.

artworks.title: River Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue and brown wash on  laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 25.2 x 39.2 cm (9 15/16 x 15 7/16 in.)
support: 35.2 x 49.5 cm (13 7/8 x 19 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with mountains, hills, a river, a bridge, people, animals, and buildings.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Elizabeth and John the Baptist (La Madonna della Scodella)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows four figures gathered closely together. The person on the far right is an adult woman, positioned in profile with her body facing left, her head turned slightly to look at the child on her lap. She has her hair styled in waves and wears a draped garment with flowing fabric. The central figures include a toddler sitting on the woman's lap, their curly hair and round face slightly turned towards another child close by. The other young child has similar curly hair, with features partly visible as they engage with the toddler. Both children are unclothed, except for drapery covering parts of their bodies. Behind them, an older woman wears a head covering with a detailed face, including a prominent nose and distinct eyes. She has her right hand raised, palm facing forward. The background is crosshatched, providing a textured, neutral backdrop to emphasize the figures.

artworks.title: The Descent from the Cross
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black and brown
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the descent from the cross. The drawing shows several figures interacting with a large cross as they lower a body down from it. The central cross is emphasized with shading and linework. Other figures are depicted in various poses around the central action. The background contains simple landscape elements. The use of contrasting lines highlights details in the scene.

artworks.title: View of the Acropolis
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The view from an elevated vantage point shows a historical site with the Parthenon in the distance. The Acropolis and its rocky terrain dominate the scene, with ancient structures visible. The image is a detailed lithograph or sepia-toned illustration with brush or pen strokes defining the architecture. The color palette includes browns, grays, and beiges. Smaller structures and trees are present, casting shadows on the ground.

artworks.title: Propylaeum
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor heightened with white over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with ancient ruins viewed from a lower angle. The ruins dominate the composition, likely part of an ancient Greek temple. The horizon is positioned in the upper portion, with the top of the structure and distant sky visible. The brushstrokes capture texture and wear of the stone columns, with subtle shading for depth. The color palette consists of muted earth tones like beiges, grays, and hints of blue. Two figures in period clothing stand near the monument, surrounded by stone remnants and a rocky surface. More ruins are hinted at in the distance on the left side.

artworks.title: House of Heinrich Schliemann
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view with an ornate, multi-story building on the right side. The building features neoclassical architecture with statues on the rooftop. The perspective is angled, showing the façade and one side of the building with arched windows and intricate detailing. The horizon is partially obscured by the building and lacks distinct elements. The brushstrokes are fine and precise, capturing the building's intricate designs. The color palette is subdued with primarily sepia tones. Pedestrians in period clothing are seen on the street, and lush trees line the edges, adding a natural contrast.

artworks.title: Theater of Herodes Atticus
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk heightened with white
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient stone structure in the distance, with arched openings dominating the upper part of the scene. In the foreground, cattle stand on a path, with trees scattered around them. A figure, potentially a herder, is on the right side. The painting has fine brushstrokes, detailed leaves on the trees, and a color palette of soft browns and grays.

artworks.title: Monument of Philopappos
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient ruin seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon line is low, with the hill and the remnants of the building in the upper part of the image. The ruin seems to be part of a larger archway or monument, with decorative carvings and niches housing sculpted figures. The brushwork appears sketch-like, capturing details and textures with careful line work and shading. The color palette is primarily in sepia tones, creating a historic feel. The earthy color contrasts with variations of gray and beige. A small figure stands to the right, seemingly admiring the monument. Patches of grass and rocks surround the ancient site, providing context to the weathered surroundings.

artworks.title: Old Market Gate
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image depicts ancient ruins with classical columns and a partly damaged architrave at street level. The horizon line is low, revealing the tops of buildings behind the columns. The brushstrokes capture fine details realistically, with a sketch-like quality in monochrome tones. The color palette is muted, using shades of sepia or brown-gray. Three figures stand closest to us, suggesting human scale and interaction. More buildings are visible in the distance, hinting at a bustling surrounding area.

artworks.title: Temple of Olympian Zeus
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk with touches of graphite
artworks.dimensions:
image (lunette): 15.3 x 15.5 cm (6 x 6 1/8 in.)
sheet: 15.9 x 15.9 cm (6 1/4 x 6 1/4 in.)
support: 48.8 x 33.7 cm (19 3/16 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins with towering classical columns as the main focus. The perspective is from ground level, looking towards the columns with a low horizon. The background includes more ancient architecture and trees, but these elements are subdued compared to the columns. The brushwork is detailed with clear lines and shading to capture the columns' designs. The color palette is muted with earthy tones like sepia. People are gathered close to the viewer, providing scale to the columns. In the distance are smaller trees and architectural elements, suggesting it is part of a larger historical area.

artworks.title: University
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over black chalk heightened with white and touches of graphite
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image features a neoclassical building with a colonnaded facade, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The building is central in the frame, with a mountainous landscape in the distance to the right. Delicate brushwork is used to capture architectural details in fine lines. The color palette is muted, with shades of brown, beige, and gray. In front of the building, a carriage is pulled by horses, and figures are scattered around, alongside lush vegetation.

artworks.title: Nike Temple
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor over touches of graphite
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 27.5 x 16.7 cm (10 13/16 x 6 9/16 in.)
support: 48.8 x 33.7 cm (19 3/16 x 13 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of an ancient temple viewed from a slightly elevated and angled perspective. The structure's architectural details are prominent, with a clear sky and a low horizon showing a landscape in the distance. The temple is depicted with precise lines showcasing classic architectural elements. The artwork uses a sepia color palette, emphasizing shadow and light play. In the bottom right corner, there is a circular inset featuring two men in traditional attire.
